pattern: ともなく / ともなしに
purpose: Describe an action without deliberate focus, or an unidentified source.
keywords: V dictionary + ともなく / ともなしに; question word + ともなく
I was gazing absently out the window.
I was listening to the radio without paying much attention.
The scent of flowers drifted in from somewhere.
formation: V dictionary + ともなく / ともなしに; question word + ともなく
restrictions: Common with 見る, 聞く, and どこから.
mistake: It does not simply negate an intentional action; it removes conscious direction.
